data.title: 空门苍 · 白色灯塔护栏边的夏风憧憬
data.description: 鸟白岛陡峭海角上的白色灯塔观景台上，海风呼啸。苍身穿校服针织背心双手抓着铁栏杆远眺海天相接之处，双马尾高高扬起，眼中闪动着向往。
data.location: high lighthouse observation balcony overlooking endless sapphire ocean under blue summer sky
data.action: gripping white painted railing, leaning forward against ocean gust, hair ties fluttering, sparkling lively gaze toward open horizon
data.lighting: 海角烈日高照与海面反射强光
data.promptProse: Ao leans eagerly against the lighthouse railing high above the blue sea, sea winds whipping her blue twintails as she gazes across the horizon.
data.animaCaption: Strong coastal winds sweep her twintails as she leans toward the sparkling ocean panorama.
